t: This is Hackney Walk, a shopping centre in Hackney. It was designed by David Adjaye, the Ghanaian-British architect. Adjaye was knighted in 2017 for services to architecture, and in 2021 he received the Royal Gold Medal, becoming its first African recipient. He is also known for the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington. So here you are looking at the work of one of the best-known architects of his generation, applied to a shopping destination.
